newsitem.title: USA: Columbia/HCA has no comment on lawsuits.
newsitem.headline: Columbia/HCA has no comment on lawsuits.

text.p: Columbia/HCA Healthcare Corp has not been served with the two shareholder complaints filed by plaintiffs' attorneys against it and cannot comment on the matter at this time, a spokeswoman for the company said Thursday.
The law firm of Kaufman Malchman Kirby & Squire LLP said it had filed a lawsuit seeking class action status on April 9.

The complaint alleged that the hospital company and certain of its directors and officers misrepresented and concealed important information related to the company's financial reports and business practices.
The lawsuit seeks damages for buyers of Columbia/HCA stock bertween February 14 1996 to March 27, according to a statement by the attorneys.
A shareholder lawsuit, also seeking class action status, was filed by the law firm of Wechster Harwood Halebian & Feffer LLP on April 8 against the company.
